svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Example deployment: a starter chat adapter on Cloud Run using GTIRelay to call the Google Threat Intelligence Agentic API

g.text: 1 The analyst @mentions the bot or DMs it, optionally attaching a file.
2 Google Chat (Google-signed ID token) or Slack (signing secret) sends an HTTPS webhook to the Cloud Run service.
3 The adapter verifies the request, acks right away (Slack allows 3 s), and posts an "Investigating…" placeholder in the thread.
4 GTIRelay sends the prompt and file to POST /agentspace/sessions, with the API key in the x-apikey header. That call blocks until the agent finishes, often for minutes.
5 Meanwhile GTIRelay polls GET /agentspace/sessions/{id} every 2 s (same header) for new agent thoughts and tool calls.
6 The adapter edits the placeholder with progress, at most once every 3 s.
7 On AGENT_FINAL_RESPONSE the adapter renders the widgets and replaces the placeholder with the report.
The model and the threat-intel tools run inside GTI. The Cloud Run service relays prompts, files, progress, and results, and makes no model calls.
